title: Seaweed Soup · Course 8
source: GGYC Manuel Fagundes Seaweed Soup Regatta 2026–27, Addendum B: Courses and Marks, Revision 1 (2026-11-05). Mark positions from the YRA (github.com/nkiesel/YRA-Marks). Main sailing instructions not available.
notes: GGYC Seaweed Soup 2026–27, course 8. About 8.9 nm. Start heading west: A to starboard, Harding Rock to starboard, Fort Mason to starboard, pass X to port, Hank Easom to port, pass X to starboard, Fort Mason to starboard, then finish. The start line runs from the flagpole on the GGYC deck out to X. X is not a rounding mark: just pass it on the side shown, which keeps you off the line. Crossing the start/finish line in the middle of the race costs a two-turn penalty.

committee.label: GGYC flagpole
committee.verify: GGYC's race deck to X. The addendum doesn't define the line; GGYC's past sailing instructions (2011 Seaweed Soup, 2010 Farallon Race, as summarised: the PDFs weren't reachable) run it from an orange marker on the race deck to X, so X is the outer end. The deck end is on the Bay side of the clubhouse (OpenStreetMap: the clubhouse, way 239024736 at 1 Yacht Road, 37.8077 N 122.4426 W, as the city's building data has it), on the jetty's north seawall (OSM coastline, 37.8080 N there). The marker's own position isn't published: this is the seawall in front of the clubhouse, within about 10 m. (It was at 37.80925 N, 130 m out in the water.)

obstructions.note: Addendum B1.1: the start/finish line is an obstruction for boats not in their starting sequence or on their first or last leg; crossing it is a two-turn penalty (SI 7.x).
